We aim to validate the real-fills performance of the VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_2DTE wiring proposal (which stages a 2DTE override onto the ATM Safe-2 cell) against the baseline 0DTE configuration, specifically measuring edge_capture on J's source-of-truth anchor days using realistic OPRA fills.

## Mechanism
